style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 122 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, ukulele and glockenspiel hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stomp like an elephant, boom, boom, boom!
Stretch like a giraffe up to the moon!
Move like the animals, here we go,
Fast and slow and high and low!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
The elephant stomps with great big feet,
Boom, boom, boom to the jungle beat!
The giraffe stretches way up high,
Reach your arms up to the sky!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Ready, steady, one, two, three,
Move like the animals, follow me!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stomp like an elephant, boom, boom, boom!
Stretch like a giraffe up to the moon!
Move like the animals, here we go,
Fast and slow and high and low!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
The zebra trots, clip, clop, clip,
Lift your knees and take a trip!
The hippo walks on the river floor,
Slow and heavy, step some more!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Stomp, stomp! (Stomp, stomp!)
Stretch up tall! (Stretch up tall!)
Trot, trot! (Trot, trot!)
Now wiggle, wiggle, one and all!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
The lion stretches after a nap,
Yawn so big and give a clap!
And Milo flaps, flap, flap, flap,
Flap your arms and take a lap!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Ready, steady, one, two, three,
Move like the animals, follow me!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Stomp like an elephant, boom, boom, boom!
Stretch like a giraffe up to the moon!
We moved like the animals, high and low,
Now take a bow, it's time to go!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Boom, boom! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Stomp Like an Elephant! Animal Moves Song with Milo
meta.description:
Stomp like an elephant! Move like the zoo animals with Milo the bluebird: stomp, stretch like a giraffe, trot like a zebra, walk slow like a hippo and flap like Milo.
An action song for kids that gets little ones moving. Real fact: hippos can walk along the river bottom. Ages 2-6.

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Characters and visuals are animated with the help of AI tools and reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
